versions.content: Com Data cyclic execution time The RTE shall proccess the com data (signal or signal group) with the effective period time configured via either: • RteComDataMainFunctionPeriod for com data without E2E transformation configured. • RteComDataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod for com data with E2E transforma- tion configured (if RteComDataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod is not configured, RteComDataMainFunctionPeriod shall be used instead).
